summary: Lord Abbett Private Credit Fund S, a non-traded Delaware BDC, filed an 8-K reporting a routine private placement of roughly 565,990 common shares at $24.64 per share, raising approximately $13.9 million, with the final share count fixed September 21, 2026. Sales were made under subscription agreements to accredited investors via Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. A Regulation FD update disclosed a $546 million commitment portfolio across 61 companies, 94% senior secured, 100% floating-rate, 9.3% weighted-average yield. No board recommendation or advisor is named. No special-situation mechanics apply; monitor NAV stability and portfolio credit trends.
